mentions.name: Deep link now
mentions.description: A privacy-focused deferred deep linking service that bridges the airgap between web links and mobile apps, sending users to the right in-app destination. It performs no tracking or analytics, so links avoid being blocked by ad blockers that target ad-tracking providers like Branch and AppsFlyer.
mentions.problem: Branch, AppsFlyer and similar deep linking providers are cross-platform ad tracking services under the hood, so links using them get blocked by ad blockers.
mentions.audience: Developers and anyone whose app links get blocked by ad blockers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Deep link now ( https://Deeplinknow.com ) - deferred deep linking for developers / people who dont want their links blocked by adockers because Branch/Appsflyer et al are actually under-the-hood cross platform ad tracking services.
